prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph so the change itself is the interface: intent, edited files, browser evidence, and acceptance read as one continuous proof.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop web app, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: A persistent left rail approximately 250px groups Repositories and nested Workspaces and never moves. To its right, one continuous mixed proof sheet scroll combines a concise agent intent block, an editable multi-file diff, inline annotations, large browser evidence, test results, and acceptance controls without breaking into dashboard cards. A tall live-preview strip remains visible at the far right and can widen into the main browser. Top chrome shows Sylph, repository, branch, search and current change state.
Content: Repository `folkhero-web`; Workspaces `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`; active task `Polish the onboarding flow`; file diffs for `src/routes/onboarding.tsx` and `src/styles/onboarding.css`; browser evidence contains a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen at desktop and 390px; annotation `Form actions no longer overflow`; status `Browser checks 4/4`; actions `Request changes`, `Accept change`, `Open live preview`.
Style/medium: Contemporary engineering proof sheet informed by Diffs-style mixed file and diff views, code review printouts, and editorial annotation. Bright off-white ground, exact code ink, pale semantic add/delete fields, strong typographic rhythm. Modern, not nostalgic.
Composition/framing: The persistent left rail is unmistakable. The proof sheet is one continuous surface with large browser evidence, not a stack of rounded cards. Code, diff, browser, and agent intent share a single reading order.
Lighting/mood: Calm, analytical, lucid, built for sustained review.
Color palette: proof white #F7F5EF, ink #171917, pale blue #D9E5FF, add #C9F0D2, delete #FFD6CE, cobalt action #2457F5.
Materials/textures: uncoated digital paper, crisp syntax ink, editorial rules, browser captures; nearly textureless.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Repositories`, `Workspaces`, `folkhero-web`, `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, `src/styles/onboarding.css`, `Form actions no longer overflow`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Request changes`, `Accept change`, `Open live preview`.
Constraints: Must read as an agentic remote IDE and change-review workspace with persistent left navigation, editable diffs, browser evidence, skills, and tests. Accessible contrast. No fake claims.
Avoid: newspaper nostalgia, paper props, generic pull request page, generic IDE chrome, bento dashboard, rounded card grid, glassmorphism, neon, marketing hero, device frame, tiny illegible text.
